career_ladder.note: Management Trainees in BEML Limited undergo 1 year training and probation before absorption into permanent executive cadre as Assistant Manager in Grade E-1, advancing across defence, mining & construction, and rail & metro manufacturing divisions.

exam_scheme.note: Selection comprises a Computer Based Written Examination (CBT) followed by an Assessment Center / Personal Interview. Final selection is based on 85% weightage for Written Test and 15% weightage for Personal Interview.

stages.source_label: BEML MT Examination Scheme and Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Part I: Discipline Specific Subject Domain Knowledge
Part II: General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning

papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% for General and 50% for Reserved categories

financial_package.note: Pay package conforms to DPE 3rd PRC IDA executive pattern. Management Trainees enter in Grade E-1 with ₹40,000 starting basic pay, mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, Bengaluru HRA (27%), and industrial perks.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BEML Terms of Recruitment and Pay Structure
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay ₹40,000, 58% IDA (₹23,200), Bengaluru HRA (27% = ₹10,800) or Company Township housing (KGF / Mysuru), Cafeteria perks (31% = ₹12,400), less statutory PF (12%) and medical deductions.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised on quarterly basis
Company Quarters in BEML Township (Bengaluru / KGF / Mysuru) or HRA @ 27%
Cafeteria Approach Allowances up to 31% of basic pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) based on annual company profitability and division MoU rating
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Defined Superannuation Pension Scheme
Comprehensive medical facilities at BEML Medical Centres / empanelled specialty hospitals
